label: Project ID
description: Unique project ID with first 4 letters of ranch name, year (YY) of practice implementation, and conservation practice abbreviation (see practice_abbreviations.csv)

label: Treatment (T) or Control ©
description: Identifies whether plot is a treatment (T) or control ©

label: Timepoint
description: Timepoint of sampling event, indicating baseline (T0), first sampling after practice implementation (T1), and following events (T2, T3, etc)

label: AWB Sampling Date
description: Date of woody biomass sampling event

label: Woody Biomass Method
description: Method used for estimating woody biomass

label: Plot Area
description: Plot area if using plot-based method for woody biomass

label: PCQ/LCH radius
description: Sampling radius if using PCQ or LCH method for woody biomass

label: Tree species identified
description: Genus and species of all identified trees within plot

label: Aboveground Woody Biomass
description: Aboveground woody biomass at plot level on per hectare basis

label: Belowground Woody Biomass
description: Belowground woody biomass at plot level on per hectare basis
